title: Issues in Social Development
modules: Theories Of Social Development - The Social Leaning,
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very sensitive issue for discussion in our country."
The child's right is a very sensitive issue for discussion in our country.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a movement to address the social, economic and political deprivation women have suffered over the years."
Gender affirmative action or gender equality is a movement to address the social, economic and political deprivation women have suffered over the years.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the deliberate act of any agent of the state in the utilization of the commonwealth or resources within a given preview for self- aggrandizement."
Corruption is the deliberate act of any agent of the state in the utilization of the commonwealth or resources within a given preview for self- aggrandizement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of demographic social, economic and physical change which usually occur in a country."
Urbanization is a process of demographic social, economic and physical change which usually occur in a country.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first agent of socialization."
The family is the first agent of socialization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conditioning situation in which the economics of one group of countries are conditioned by the development and expansion of others."
Dependency is a conditioning situation in which the economics of one group of countries are conditioned by the development and expansion of others.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important security issue in the world today."
Environmental security is a very important security issue in the world today.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered as the pillar of the family."
Boys are considered as the pillar of the family.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of social change, not merely a set of policies and programmes instituted for some specific results."
Social development is a process of social change, not merely a set of policies and programmes instituted for some specific results.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means sharing power among individuals and groups within a state (Weber, 1947)."
Politics to him means sharing power among individuals and groups within a state (Weber, 1947).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a factor in the urbanization process."
The market forces is a factor in the urbanization process.
fib: ______ is an offshoot of the concept of globalization.
Globalization theory
Globalization theory is an offshoot of the concept of globalization.
______ is the greatest in the poorest countries.
educational gender gap
The educational gender gap is the greatest in the poorest countries.
______ is a basic objective of development.
Health
Health is a basic objective of development.
______ is responsible for the underdevelopment of the country many years after independence.
Corruption in Nigeria
Corruption in Nigeria is responsible for the underdevelopment of the country many years after independence.
______ is one of the most frequently used words in discussions relating to development, trade and international political economy.
Globalization
Globalization is one of the most frequently used words in discussions relating to development, trade and international political economy.
______ is a global issue since women all ever the world are involved.
Gender issue
Gender issue is a global issue since women all ever the world are involved.
______ is the progressive movement from traditional society to the stage of high mass consumption of goods and services.
Development
Development is the progressive movement from traditional society to the stage of high mass consumption of goods and services.
______ is a response to the discrimination and unfair treatment women were subjected to in Nigeria and other parts of the world.
gender affirmative action
The gender affirmative action is a response to the discrimination and unfair treatment women were subjected to in Nigeria and other parts of the world.
______ can be defined as "meeting the needs of the present generation" without compromising the needs of the future generation (Soubbotina, 2004).
Sustainable Development
Sustainable Development can be defined as "meeting the needs of the present generation" without compromising the needs of the future generation (Soubbotina, 2004).

______ is an artificial creation that can be related to concretely through the institutions set up in its name to define it as well as make decisions as to the organization and regulation of the public domain.
state

A state is an artificial creation that can be related to concretely through the institutions set up in its name to define it as well as make decisions as to the organization and regulation of the public domain.
